functionDeclarations.name: generate_eight_dir_sprite
functionDeclarations.description: Create eight-direction sprites in three reviewed stages using this ONE tool. Call step=sheet, then after reviewing the result call step=video with parent_task_id, then after reviewing the video call step=slice with its task ID. Do not auto-chain without user confirmation. All stages return task_id; use check_task until completed. Sheet uses ordinary Frontier pricing; video uses Seedance 2.5 (default) or MiniMax H3 Max pricing; slice is always free. Each cost confirmation authorizes only its own stage; there is no extra workflow charge. Ask for a reference image or character_hint and the action before sheet generation. Before step=video, ask the user to choose video model doubao-seedance-2-5-260628 (default) or MiniMax-H3-Max. One sheet per call; redo creates another separately billed task. Output: direction-named PNG sequences and preview GIF. Not the 4x4 generate_sprite_animation workflow.

character_hint.description: Sheet stage: character description, required without a reference image (including custom action).

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned high-cost quote. Below the server threshold (default 500 credits), proceed without confirmation. Quotes expire in 30 minutes and are single-use. Use returned confirmation_arguments if provided; otherwise keep parameters unchanged. If rejected, obtain a fresh quote with false/omitted and ask for approval again. Repeated true calls never issue new authorization.

custom_description.description: Sheet stage: required for custom action.

duration.description: Video seconds. Seedance 2.5: 4–15 (default 4). MiniMax-H3-Max: 5–15 (default 5). Charged using ordinary video pricing.

fps.description: Slice rate 1–12; default 12. Input max 64 MiB, 15s, 1920px edge; total sampled pixels at most 64 million.

functionDeclarations.name: generate_game_ui_kit
functionDeclarations.description: Generate a game UI asset kit in two async steps: Use this workflow only when the user explicitly requests independently layered UI assets. A UI screenshot or transparent image alone uses generate_image; do not infer permission to decompose it. Step 1 (no screenshot_url) generates a screenshot; step 2 (with screenshot_url) extracts UI assets. seedream (default) uses Seedream 5.5 for both steps, with 1 base image + up to 16 transparent UI layers and metadata. Explicit seedream_pro retains Pro. qwen uses Seedream 5.5 for the screenshot and Qwen for layering (default 4 layers). For personal-lite and non-paid subscribers, the server changes all Pro requests to the qwen workflow before cost confirmation; confirm_cost cannot override this. frontier_flare (Flare/全能耀斑) generates the screenshot and a magenta cutout sheet for manual slicing. quality/output_format only apply to frontier_flare. High-cost gate: each Seedream 5.5/Pro/Flare step is evaluated separately against the estimated-total threshold (default 500 credits). Lower-cost steps proceed directly; qwen does not trigger this gate. Each estimate covers only the current step; if step 2 returns a cost prompt, step 1 consent cannot approve it. Seedream step 2 quotes at most17 outputs including base; 5.5 settles one input plus each output's actual pixel tier. Async: returns task_id and shell poll metadata. Follow the task result's ONE-background-subagent wait instructions at poll_interval_seconds, then check_task once. IMPORTANT: For step 2, pass the screenshot image URL as screenshot_url with the effective workflow provider RETURNED by step 1, including qwen after a subscription fallback.

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned high-cost quote. Below the server threshold (default 500 credits), proceed without confirmation. Quotes expire in 30 minutes and are single-use. Use returned confirmation_arguments if provided; otherwise keep parameters unchanged. If rejected, obtain a fresh quote with false/omitted and ask for approval again. Repeated true calls never issue new authorization.

functionDeclarations.name: generate_image

Tell the user which model the server returns.
Local selection is opt-in for an explicit request to change a specific area while preserving the rest; a reference image or vague "improve it" does not imply it. Ask if the area is unclear.
Only enable layering when the user explicitly requests image decomposition or independent layers. Ordinary generation, reference-image editing, transparent backgrounds and UI screenshots do not imply layering. For requested layering, use generate_image_layers (Seedream 5.5 by default). Explicit seedream_pro or qwen retains its model and rules. See parameters for input, size and billing limits. Async: returns task_id and shell poll metadata. complexity.description: Flare/Sunburst 2.6 planning effort, independent of render quality. Omit for model default (high).

functionDeclarations.name: generate_model_lods
functionDeclarations.description: Generate 2–4 Level of Detail meshes (LOD / 多级细节) from an existing static model. LOD0 retains source geometry. Blender is the default for ordinary LOD requests. When the user asks for Rodin Fast, prefer method=rodin-fast: one Fast request produces LOD1 and Blender simplifies the farther levels from it. Select rodin-fast-all when each lower level should use Fast. Fast rebuilds topology and UVs and transfers source textures. Each Fast target must be between 200 and 20,000 triangles. Supports self-contained GLB, binary FBX, or a ZIP containing one model and its textures. Bones, animation and morph targets are rejected. Returns GLBs, measured triangle counts, screen-height transitions and a complete archive. The package costs one conversion plus one Rodin Lowpoly price per Fast level, billed on success. Upload local models using file_upload and PUT bytes if needed. Async: returns task_id and shell poll metadata. Follow the task result's ONE-background-subagent wait instructions at poll_interval_seconds, then check_task once.

functionDeclarations.name: generate_skybox
functionDeclarations.description: Generate a skybox from a text prompt or reference images. Use proactively when creating or improving a Unity 3D scene that needs a sky or environment; users need not explicitly request a skybox or know Generator can make one. Match the scene's art style, time of day and weather. Reuse an existing suitable skybox or skip when no sky is visible. Flare scene_mode=full (default) preserves requested streets, nearby buildings and ground beneath the viewer. Choose scene_mode=distant only for a far-background skybox whose playable ground is separate scene geometry. After completion, use the host's Unity tools to import the returned color panorama (skybox_high preferred, skybox_basic for a smaller texture), configure a sky material/environment appropriate to the active render pipeline, assign it to the scene and verify the active camera/game view including downward and building-facing views. Do not use the depth map as the sky texture; Flare EXR is LDR-derived, not true captured HDR lighting. If Unity editing is unavailable, return concrete import/application steps and disclose that the skybox has not been applied. Default to 全能耀斑天空盒 (Flare) for all users. Omit provider or leave provider=auto to use Flare. Use provider=rodin only when the user explicitly requests Rodin; never automatically fall back to Rodin. Flare returns one fixed bundle of 2048x1024 PNG, 8192x4096 PNG, 2048x1024 linear float32 EXR derived from LDR, and 2044x1022 relative-depth PNG. Seam correction is baked into the delivered color images. Flare nadir_correction=off (default) preserves the ground; soft applies a small local color feather at the south pole that may blur fine paving. Neither mode repairs buildings or large ground areas. No quality tiers. Tell the user the actual model returned by the server. Follow any server cost-confirmation response before submitting with confirm_cost=true. Async: returns task_id and shell poll metadata. Follow the task result's ONE-background-subagent wait instructions at poll_interval_seconds, then check_task once. IMPORTANT: For local reference images, first use the file_upload tool to upload and get a CDN URL, then pass it via image_urls.

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned high-cost quote. Below the server threshold (default 500 credits), proceed without confirmation. Quotes expire in 30 minutes and are single-use. Use returned confirmation_arguments if provided; otherwise keep parameters unchanged. If rejected, obtain a fresh quote with false/omitted and ask for approval again. Repeated true calls never issue new authorization.

prompt.description: Describe the requested 360-degree scene, art style, palette, time of day and weather (required if no image_urls). Full scene mode retains streets, plazas, nearby buildings and ground; distant mode is for a background with separate playable geometry.

provider.description: Skybox provider: auto (default; always Flare), flare, or rodin (only when explicitly requested by the user; no automatic fallback)

Check loop seams before enabling looping. Do not stop at a download link. If Unity editing is unavailable, provide concrete integration steps and state that the sound has not been connected. If rejected, obtain a fresh quote with false/omitted and ask for approval again. Repeated true calls never issue new authorization.

functionDeclarations.name: generate_sprite_animation
functionDeclarations.description: Generate a transparent PNG 4×4 grid sprite sheet (16 frames) via frontier_flare (全能耀斑) with native background removal. ONE continuous animation per call: all 16 frames form one chronological sequence, left-to-right then top-to-bottom; motion continues across row boundaries. Rows/columns are not directions, actions or variants. Do not assign content to individual rows, cells or numbered frames. Generate independent actions or directional variants in separate calls, each producing a full 16-frame sheet (four directions = four calls). Resolve and split user requirements before calling; prompt wording cannot reconfigure this fixed output contract. Static images use generate_image; eight-direction sheets use generate_eight_dir_sprite. Includes guidance for cutting all 16 frames into ONE animation clip. If image_urls is provided, the sprite sheet is based on the reference image(s); otherwise generated from the text prompt alone. Async: returns task_id and shell poll metadata. Follow the task result's ONE-background-subagent wait instructions at poll_interval_seconds, then check_task once. IMPORTANT: For local reference images, first use the file_upload tool to upload and get a CDN URL, then pass it via image_urls.

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned high-cost quote. Below the server threshold (default 500 credits), proceed without confirmation. Quotes expire in 30 minutes and are single-use. Use returned confirmation_arguments if provided; otherwise keep parameters unchanged. If rejected, obtain a fresh quote with false/omitted and ask for approval again. Repeated true calls never issue new authorization.

image_urls.description: Comma-separated CDN image URLs for reference-image mode. References guide character identity and visual style, not their grid layout, direction grouping or frame allocation. Use the file_upload tool to get a presigned upload URL, upload the file bytes via curl, then pass the CDN file_url here.

output_format.description: Output is always PNG to preserve native transparency; legacy jpeg/webp requests are normalized to PNG.

prompt.description: Describe the subject, style, viewpoint and ONE continuous motion (e.g. front-facing walk cycle, coin spin). Describe motion phases naturally; do not prescribe row/cell/frame assignments, multiple independent directional cycles or another layout. The tool owns the fixed 4x4 / 16-frame layout. Maximum prompt length: 31477 Unicode characters.

quality.description: Sprite quality is fixed to medium; legacy quality overrides are normalized to medium.

session_id.description: Optional agent-injected session ID for grouping tasks.

workspace_name.description: Optional agent-injected primary workspace directory name for grouping tasks.

functionDeclarations.name: generate_sprite_atlas
functionDeclarations.description: Pack multiple sprite images into a single atlas texture. Downloads all input images, arranges them using shelf-packing, and composites into one PNG/JPEG atlas. Returns the atlas image URL and a JSON layout describing each sprite's position (x, y) and size (w, h). Supported input formats: PNG, JPEG, GIF (WebP is NOT supported). This is a synchronous operation — the result is returned immediately (no task_id polling needed). IMPORTANT: Input images must already be uploaded to CDN. Use file_upload first for local images, then pass the CDN URLs via image_urls.

image_urls.description: Comma-separated CDN URLs of individual sprite images to pack (use file_upload first for local files)

output_format.description: Output image format (default: png). JPEG does not support transparency.

power_of_two.description: Force atlas dimensions to power-of-two (default: true)

session_id.description: Optional agent-injected session ID for grouping tasks.

workspace_name.description: Optional agent-injected primary workspace directory name for grouping tasks.

functionDeclarations.name: generate_tts
functionDeclarations.description: Read the user's exact text as speech. Use voice_id from search_tts_voices (or an owned voice_clone result), OR voice_query to let the server choose from real voices; omit both for a default narrator. Never put voice instructions in prompt or rewrite the spoken text; send tone/mood through emotion, and use voice_query only to pick who the voice sounds like. The selected voice determines its provider automatically and is returned with the task. For a named character, never substitute a different character; an unavailable/ambiguous voice returns candidates without creating a task. Reuse the returned voice ID for subsequent lines of the same character. No voice cloning/design is performed implicitly. Async: returns task_id and shell poll metadata. Follow the task result's ONE-background-subagent wait instructions at poll_interval_seconds, then check_task once.

audio_format.description: Default mp3. Use a format listed on the selected voice; unsupported formats fail before task creation.

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned high-cost quote. Below the server threshold (default 500 credits), proceed without confirmation. Quotes expire in 30 minutes and are single-use. Use returned confirmation_arguments if provided; otherwise keep parameters unchanged. If rejected, obtain a fresh quote with false/omitted and ask for approval again. Repeated true calls never issue new authorization.

emotion.description: Delivery the user asked for — tone, mood, emotion — belongs here, not in voice_query. When the 9 values cannot capture it and the voice supports emotionPrompt, use emotion_prompt instead. Support depends on the chosen voice: MiniMax voices accept all 9 values; Volc 2.0 official voices and Qwen voices apply it as a natural-language instruction; Volc 1.0 multi-emotion voices accept a subset; fal clones accept 7 (no calm/fluent). Voices whose search_tts_voices entry has no `emotions` reject this parameter — check that list before sending.

emotion_prompt.description: Free-form delivery description the 9 emotion values cannot express, e.g. 慵懒地、带一点嘲讽 (max 60 characters). Mutually exclusive with emotion. Qwen and Volc 2.0 official voices only — check emotionPrompt in search_tts_voices; other voices reject it because they have no instruction channel. Describe delivery only: do not ask for speed, volume or language changes here (use speed/vol/language_boost).

emotion_scale.description: Optional emotion intensity 1–5 (upstream default 4). Volc 1.0 multi-emotion voices only; requires emotion and is rejected for other voices.

language_boost.description: Optional pronunciation language, e.g. Chinese or English. Omit for default. Does not translate prompt.

pitch.description: MiniMax only: -12–12 semitones; default 0. Omit for Volc/Qwen/volc_voicelib.

prompt.description: Exact spoken text, 1–9999 characters. Keep voice identity requirements in voice_query and tone in emotion. volc_voicelib (purchased voice library) voices accept at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes (~341 Chinese characters) per request; longer text must be split into separate tasks.

quality.description: high (default); fast selects MiniMax Turbo and only applies to MiniMax voices.

sample_rate.description: Optional sample rate. MiniMax defaults 32000; Volc/Qwen/volc_voicelib default 24000. Qwen also supports 12000/48000; only mono.

voice_id.description: Exact canonical ID returned by search_tts_voices, or your previous voice_clone customVoiceId. Mutually exclusive with voice_query. Legacy valid MiniMax IDs remain accepted.

voice_query.description: Optional natural language request for WHO the voice should sound like — identity, timbre, accent — e.g. 低沉温柔的中文男声 or 熊二 2.0. Server resolves it; do not guess an ID. functionDeclarations.name: generate_video
functionDeclarations.description: Generate video from text, image frames, or reference media. Choose provider/model using their descriptions; mode defines accepted inputs. Use a single portrait library per video. Async: returns task_id and shell poll metadata. Follow the task result's ONE-background-subagent wait instructions at poll_interval_seconds, then check_task once.

audio_urls.description: Comma-separated audio CDN references for mood, rhythm, voice or pacing. Allowed modes, counts and audio-only restrictions: see mode.

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned high-cost quote. Below the server threshold (default 500 credits), proceed without confirmation. Quotes expire in 30 minutes and are single-use. Use returned confirmation_arguments if provided; otherwise keep parameters unchanged. If rejected, obtain a fresh quote with false/omitted and ask for approval again. Repeated true calls never issue new authorization.

duration.description: Output seconds, default 5. Seedance 2.0 uses 4–15s (16–60s splits into segments); the 2.5 series uses 4–30s in a single clip. With Seedance reference video, -1 lets the model choose and the estimate uses the model's maximum output duration. MiniMax-H3: 4–60s (>15s splits); MiniMax-H3-Max: 5–15s.

generate_audio.description: Seedance only, default true. MiniMax always generates audio natively.

image_urls.description: Comma-separated image CDN URLs. Check both pixel dimensions before submitting: Seedance needs at least 300 px per side; MiniMax-H3 reference images need 256–5760 px per side. Counts and frame order: see mode.

mode.description: text_to_video: no media. first_frame: 1 image; first_last_frame: 2 ordered images (first, last); both frame modes reject video/audio. Seedance reference_image: at least 1 image, no video/audio. Seedance multimodal: requires video or audio; image-only input uses reference_image. Reference limits (images/videos/audios): Seedance 2.0=9/3/3; 2.5=30/10/10; 2.5 Flash=10/5/5. Seedance 2.0 audio needs an image/video; the 2.5 series allows audio-only. MiniMax-H3: reference_image and multimodal are the same reference mode, max 9/3/3 and 12 files total, requiring an image or video; prefer multimodal for video/audio. MiniMax-H3-Max supports only text_to_video/first_frame/first_last_frame.

model.description: Seedance default: doubao-seedance-2-0-mini-260615. When the user explicitly requests Seedance 2.5 Flash or 2.5 Lite, use doubao-seedance-2-5-flash-261115 (Volcengine Ark). Other model IDs are listed in the enum. MiniMax default: MiniMax-H3. MiniMax-H3-Max is higher quality but has restricted modes, duration and resolution (see those parameters). doubao-seedance-2-5-260628 (higher credit cost) and MiniMax-H3-Max require explicit user requests.

prompt.description: English for Seedance; Chinese/English for MiniMax. Required for Seedance text_to_video and every MiniMax mode. Seedance multimodal references use @Image N, @Video N, @Audio N, e.g. "@Video 1 for camera movement; @Image 1 for style".

provider.description: seedance2 (default): ByteDance Seedance 2.0 and 2.5 series. minimax_h3: MiniMax/Hailuo H3 or H3 Max. Choose MiniMax when explicitly named or when 2K, 60s, or Chinese prompts are needed. Select the variant via model; see mode/duration/resolution for limits.

ratio.description: Seedance: adaptive by default; the 2.5 series forces adaptive for first_frame/first_last_frame and multimodal with video. MiniMax: text_to_video defaults to 16:9 (adaptive forbidden); image/reference modes default to adaptive, following input images.

resolution.description: Seedance 2.5: 480p/720p/1080p (1080p is 10-bit H.265). Seedance 2.0 standard: 480p/720p/1080p/4k (4k is 10-bit H.265). Seedance 2.5 Flash and 2.0 fast/mini: 480p/720p only. Seedance defaults to 720p; 1080p/4k are unavailable to internal @unity.cn accounts. MiniMax-H3: 768P/2K (default 768P; 480p/720p map to 768P). MiniMax-H3-Max: 480P/768P only (default 768P; 480p maps to 480P, 720p to 768P); no 2K.

functionDeclarations.name: publish_inspiration_game
functionDeclarations.description:
Codely's official game sharing. “能分享嘛” or “同意” to an invitation authorizes publication of the current verified game. Publish directly, without a hosting menu or extra confirmation. Sharing and poster rendering are free. Default to unlisted; Public requires explicit choice. Both stay outside the catalog.
1. Use only the tested runnable package (100 MiB packaged, 256 MiB expanded, up to 512 entries). For Windows, ZIP the exported player directory with its .exe at the root. For Android, use the signed APK. For H5/WebGL, ZIP the self-contained build with index.html at the root. Use relative asset URLs, such as Vite base './', and keep the game playable in an opaque-origin sandbox without origin storage or credentials. H5 signals on successful load by default. Delayed initialization sets window.codelyWaitForGameReady=true before load and calls window.codelyGameReady?.() when ready. WebGL calls the same function after initialization. Pass native_launch_key only when already configured in the native build.
2. Reuse the tested package and existing playtest screenshot. Call prepare with stable request_id, title, build_type, exact size_bytes and confirmed=true; include an accepted recommendation_id. It returns upload_url plus an optional poster_upload_url and draft_image_id. Reuse request_id and inputs on retry.
3. Use ONE literal curl command (curl.exe on Windows): --disable --fail-early --fail-with-body -H "Content-Type: CONTENT_TYPE" --upload-file "PACKAGE" "UPLOAD_URL". Append --next --fail-with-body --upload-file "SCREENSHOT" "POSTER_UPLOAD_URL" for the existing screenshot. Substitute full returned URLs directly; no shell variables, scripts, output files or redirects. Send no Authorization header. HTTP 204 is success. Skip already-uploaded builds and absent screenshots. A refreshed prepare renews URLs.
4. Call finish with the same request_id and selection={title,source:"screenshot",draft_image_id,tagline} when a screenshot was uploaded. A preview is optional for direct authorized sharing; preserve the exact selection/token if one was approved. No selection uses a title-only poster. Use web_fetch once on play_url to check reachability/title, then show the supplied link and inline poster (QR fallback) with full URLs. This one read completes acceptance; do not follow game assets, repeat playtests, inspect images, generate art or write verification scripts. A poster error does not invalidate the game link.
5. For a requested cover update or retry, use action=poster, the share's game_id or play_url, confirmed=true, a stable operation_id, the selection, and previous_version from the latest receipt (empty for a missing poster). For withdraw, pass either game_id or play_url.

confirmed.description: True in prepare or poster after the user agrees.

operation_id.description: Stable ID for a cover update or retry.

request_id.description: Stable ID for prepare and finish.

Omit action for a quick invitation; no image work is required before asking. An invite result requires ending the turn and waiting for a user reply; it never authorizes publishing by itself. A direct “能分享嘛” or an accepted invitation goes straight to publish_inspiration_game. Only use prepare_image/preview when the user requests a cover preview or edit: PUT an existing screenshot to the signed URL, then preview with draft_image_id. Use a short game-specific tagline. source=text is the no-image fallback. Background generation is optional and only follows an explicit request, background_quote and approval of the reference and credits.

functionDeclarations.name: rodin_lowpoly_remesh
functionDeclarations.description: Reduce an existing 3D model with Rodin Lowpoly. Provide an owned Rodin asset_id with its generation inputs or an uploaded model_url. Uploaded models retain their original textures by default. Assets can generate new textures using material. Defaults to 4,000 target triangles, quad-dominant geometry and FBX. Use generate_3d_model for new models. Async: returns task_id and shell poll metadata. Follow the task result's ONE-background-subagent wait instructions at poll_interval_seconds, then check_task once.

asset_id.description: Your completed Rodin task ID or asset UUID. For prior uploaded-model or rigging results, use the model file URL.

confirm_cost.description: True only after explicit user approval of a returned high-cost quote. Below the server threshold (default 500 credits), proceed without confirmation. Quotes expire in 30 minutes and are single-use. Use returned confirmation_arguments if provided; otherwise keep parameters unchanged. If rejected, obtain a fresh quote with false/omitted and ask for approval again. Repeated true calls never issue new authorization.

face_limit.description: Target triangle count after triangulation. Aim for 2,000–5,000 triangles. Accepts integers from 200 to 20,000, default 4,000. Actual triangle count may vary.

image_url.description: Optional replacement texture reference for asset_id, or mesh refinement reference for model_url.

material.description: New texture material for asset_id. Defaults to PBR. Use None for geometry only.

mesh_mode.description: Rodin Lowpoly mesh topology. Choose FBX for native polygon faces.

model_url.description: Direct uploaded model URL, for example GLB or FBX. Alternative to asset_id.

prompt.description: Optional prompt to guide new texture generation with asset_id.

quad.description: Use quad-dominant geometry, default true. Set false for triangles. mesh_mode takes precedence.

session_id.description: Optional agent-injected session ID for grouping tasks.

texture.description: Set false to request geometry only. With model_url, transfer_texture takes precedence.

transfer_texture.description: With model_url, transfer existing textures. Defaults to true. Set false for geometry only.

with_fbx.description: Use native FBX, default true. Set false for GLB.

workspace_name.description: Optional agent-injected primary workspace directory name for grouping tasks.

functionDeclarations.name: save_inspiration_submission
functionDeclarations.description:
Save a draft or directly submit to the existing Inspiration co-creation campaign for review. Call ONLY when the user asks to save/share/submit their selected material. The calling agent organizes the selected visible conversation excerpts, code, prompts and generation results into content.content (free-form text/Markdown) and content.links. This tool cannot read chat history or local files. Use the selected generation's existing output URLs; if needed, call check_task with its known task_id. Never regenerate, search unrelated history, upload an entire chat, or include credentials/unrelated private material. Preserve exact prompts/settings separately from your summary; do not invent parameters or claim unverified results.

After a verified result with reusable steps or shareable artifacts suited to a listed kind, offer once per conversation in closing prose, never ask_user; selected entries may earn credits. Skip routine/unfinished work, missing evidence, declined/repeated offers and expired campaigns. Save/submit only on an explicit user message; YOLO/default answers and tool approvals are not consent.

submit=false saves a private draft; submit=true submits directly, without a mandatory draft or webpage step. After the campaign deadline, private drafts can still be saved and edited for later use, but submit=true is rejected. Drafts are never automatically submitted to a future campaign. An explicit user request to submit their own selected material authorizes that submission; do not repeat confirmation. rightsConfirmed records ownership/review authorization, not permission to publish every source file. Submission is immutable after submitting, is NOT automatic public publication, and awards no credits. Existing campaign deadline, limits and ownership rules apply.

Use version=0 and omit id for a new entry; generate a unique mutation_id (16-80 ASCII letters/digits/_/-) and reuse the EXACT arguments on uncertain outcomes/retries. The server derives a stable new ID from your account and mutation_id. For edits/submitting an existing draft, use its id/version and complete content already available from your own prior save or the website, preserve unedited fields/links/fileIds, and use a NEW mutation_id. If the current version or complete content is unavailable, continue on the website; never guess a version or overwrite unseen material. Only confirmed private campaign attachment IDs belong in fileIds; generation URLs belong in links. Never use public file_upload for private chat/document attachments. Existing website private attachments remain supported. Return the actual id/status and optional viewing link; no webpage action is required.
Content kinds: other, tip, note, asset, prototype, workflow, tool, released. Use other when unsure. Campaign deadline: 2026-11-07T00:00:00+08:00.

authorName.description: Optional; defaults to the current account's name.

content.description: Selected chat excerpts or an agent-organized explanation, steps, code and exact prompts/settings. Free-form text/Markdown is preserved.

fileIds.description: Existing private campaign attachment IDs owned by this account; not task IDs or public URLs.

kind.description: Content kind listed in this tool description, or other when unsure.

url.description: Existing generated output, repository or document HTTPS link. Incomplete links are allowed only in drafts.

rightsConfirmed.description: Required true for submission: user owns/is authorized to share the selected material for campaign review. Do not invent ownership or broader publication permission.

id.description: Existing draft ID; omit only for a new submission with version=0.

mutation_id.description: Unique save operation key. Reuse unchanged on retries; change only for a new intentional edit.

submit.description: false: save draft; true: formally submit for review, after which content is locked.

version.description: 0 for new entries; otherwise the version read with the draft. Never guess or advance it after an error.

functionDeclarations.name: search_audio_lib
functionDeclarations.description:
Search Codely's audio asset library: themed, game-ready sound groups (SFX sets, music tracks, ambience) indexed from Unity Asset Store free packs. Each result is ONE sound group -- a small zip containing all sibling clips of the same theme (e.g. every 'Footsteps_Grass_Run' variation) with Unity .meta files under a deterministic import path (source layout anonymized); downloading delivers the whole group zip. Every result carries event metadata: event_type, duration (sampled from the first clip), loop flag and clip_count; preview_url is a 1h presigned link you can listen to before downloading.

Map the user's request to an event_type (the primary filter, from real user demand frequency): attack(攻击/命中/挥砍/射击) | ui(按钮点击/确认/悬停/滑条) | ambient(环境/天气/氛围) | victory(胜利/升级/结算) | magic(魔法/技能/施法) | voice(人声/语音) | pickup(拾取/金币/收集) | damage(受伤/死亡) | explosion(爆炸) | monster(怪物吼叫) | door(门/机关) | jump(跳跃/落地) | footstep(脚步/移动) | music(BGM/场景音乐) | horror(恐怖/惊吓/突惊) | animal(动物叫声) | vehicle(载具/交通). Put the remaining specifics (material/mood/context, e.g. '金属 清脆', '金币 愉悦') into the free-text query; group names, context paths and clip file names are heavily tokenized and match well. Optional filters: category (music|sound-fx|ambient), min_duration/max_duration (seconds; e.g. short UI stabs max_duration=1, looping ambience min_duration=30), loop (true=loop-ready BGM/ambience, false=one-shot), format (wav|mp3|ogg|aif|flac|m4a). Example: '拾取金币音效，清脆愉悦' -> event=pickup, query='金币 清脆 愉悦'.

Free search; returns metadata and audio_id (group id), up to limit matches with offset pagination. Zero-hit queries fall back to AI semantic ranking (rank_source=jev_fallback). Search purposefully: a task normally needs 1-2 queries. Do NOT enumerate the catalog by paging offsets or varying keywords -- per-user search is rate limited per minute and capped by a daily result quota. To acquire a group, pass its audio_id to download_audio_lib (first download charges credits, repeat downloads of the same group are free). Search-only requests stop at results.

limit.description: Max sound groups to return per call, 1-20 (default 5).

loop.description: Loop flag filter: true=loop-ready (BGM/ambience loops), false=one-shot.

max_duration.description: Max duration in seconds (>0 to enable), e.g. 1 for short one-shot UI stabs. Groups with unknown duration are excluded.

min_duration.description: Min duration in seconds (>0 to enable), e.g. 30 for looping ambience/BGM.

offset.description: Zero-based match index to page from. 0 (default) = start at the best match.

query.description: Free-text qualifiers: material/mood/context words, e.g. '金币 清脆 愉悦', 'metal crisp', 'footstep gravel'. Can be empty when event alone is specific enough.

session_id.description: Optional agent-injected session ID for grouping tasks.

workspace_name.description: Optional agent-injected primary workspace directory name for grouping tasks.

functionDeclarations.name: search_effect_lib
functionDeclarations.description:
Search the particle effects library. Returns up to `limit` matches per call, best match first; `offset` pages beyond the returned list.

Use to find/reuse existing particle effects. Explicit generation/production requests use generation tools directly. Includes 1300+ ready-made toon effects.

When building or improving Unity gameplay, proactively search for suitable existing effects for hits, explosions, spells, pickups or weather, even if the user does not explicitly ask for particles or know this library exists. Infer keywords from the gameplay event, scene style and palette; reuse suitable project effects and respect minimal-effect requests. Select a relevant, style-compatible result; do not force an unrelated match.

After selecting an effect, use download_effect and follow its import guide, preserving the prefab's dependencies and .meta files. Use the host's Unity tools to attach or spawn it at the relevant event or scene object, adjust scale, orientation, timing and lifetime/looping, and verify rendering and playback with the project's render pipeline. Do not stop at search results or a download link. If Unity editing is unavailable, provide concrete integration steps and state that the effect has not been connected.

Searching does NOT cost credits and does NOT download anything. It returns effect metadata (name, category, color, type, dependencies) and an `effect_id` per match. Pick the best match for the task — do NOT download everything returned.

**To actually download an effect, call `download_effect` with the returned `effect_id`** — that is when credits are charged (first download only, re-downloads are free). When the response is marked as a semantic fallback (zero keyword matches), the order is AI-ranked relevance, not keyword match.

limit.description: Max effects to return per call, 1-20 (default 5).

offset.description: Zero-based match index to page from. 0 (default) = start at the best match.

query.description: Search keywords, e.g. 'fire explosion', 'blue magic', 'sword slash', 'rain', 'heal', 'muzzleflash blue'

session_id.description: Optional agent-injected session ID for grouping tasks.

workspace_name.description: Optional agent-injected primary workspace directory name for grouping tasks.

functionDeclarations.name: search_inspirations
functionDeclarations.description: Proactively discover game ideas, beginner starter projects, original creation prompts, tutorials and templates in the Inspiration Center; never personal history. Search early for open-ended onboarding or capability questions ("你能干什么", "what can you do?") and vague game-creation requests without a chosen game ("给我做个游戏", "make me a game"), as well as when a user is new, unsure what game/project to make, asks how to start or describes a starter mechanic. The user does not need to explicitly say they are a beginner. For these onboarding requests, finish the reply after presenting the starter choices so the client can show its cards; do not use ask_user to duplicate project selection, auto-select a default game, or begin implementation. Let the user choose a card or reply with a choice. For these broad prompts, use a beginner starter-game discovery query rather than searching the literal capability question. An explicit request for references is not required. For beginner discovery use starter_only=true and top_k=3 to present up to three relevant curated text-prompt starter games (ordinary showcase games are excluded), with their start-creating actions before asking a long setup questionnaire. Keep each reply to at most three inspiration choices; do not repeat searches or read extra items just to expand the same reply. Offer more choices only when the user asks. Respect explicit requirements and existing project context; do not interrupt unrelated debugging with recommendations. Read selected matches with get_inspiration before detailed claims; reuse results for the same topic. Partial/error does not mean no match. Synchronous and free; search/preview never starts creation or charges.

query.description: Current game idea/problem or beginner uncertainty (for example: first game, what should I build), stage and explicit constraints.

starter_only.description: Use true for beginner/first-game discovery: return only curated starter projects, excluding ordinary showcase games. Default false.

top_k.description: Maximum references returned, default 3. Return at most three choices per reply, including beginner discovery. Does not limit the catalog scan.

functionDeclarations.name: search_learn_courses
functionDeclarations.description: Find learning resources for Unity. Use this tool when the user wants to learn Unity or find Unity tutorials, courses, lessons, guides, examples, or practice projects, even if they do not mention a specific learning platform. Search Unity 中文课堂 for courses, tutorials, learning projects, and quizzes. Query is optional for browsing; when provided, use one language with 1–3 core concepts and do not append translations, synonyms, or generic terms. Filter by skill level or tutorial price when useful. Use get_learn_course_detail to inspect a selected result. Present learning resource links using url exactly as returned, preserving all query parameters.

query.description: An optional concise, single-language query containing 1-3 core concepts. Omit it to browse learning resources.

price_mode.description: Optional tutorial price filter. When set, the search returns tutorials only.

functionDeclarations.name: search_model_lib
functionDeclarations.description:
Search Codely's platform-maintained 3D model catalog: ready-made prefabs/meshes with dependency ZIPs. This is the only 3D catalog (all ready-made models, including open-license prefabs/animations, live here), so every model request goes through this tool. Separate from search_my_assets (explicitly requested personal generation history). For new-model requests, follow the routing policy in the served instructions: for readily-available subjects, search this library first and present ready-made download vs generation to the user; generate with generate_3d_model only when no suitable match exists or the user explicitly wants generation.

Free search; returns metadata and model_id, up to limit matches with offset pagination; models with rendered previews also carry preview_urls (public, stable image links -- show them to the user to help pick a model). Semantic fallback results are AI-ranked; verify suitability. Use sort=recent with a category keyword to browse the newest ingested models. Search purposefully with 2-3 core nouns (e.g. `AK47 rifle`, `wooden barrel`, `low poly tree`): a task normally needs 1-2 queries. Do NOT pass a full sentence or a long generation prompt -- the catalog index matches word by word, and extra descriptive words drop matches to zero; a short fallback only partially recovers them. Do NOT enumerate the catalog by paging offsets, varying keywords or both -- per-user search is rate limited per minute and capped by a daily result quota; hitting the cap means no more search results today. To acquire a selected model, pass its model_id to download_model_lib (first download charges credits, repeats free). Search-only requests stop at results; do not download all matches or turn an empty search into generation.

after.description: Opaque cursor for sort=recent browsing. Pass the `next_cursor` from the previous response to fetch the next page without offset.

category.description: Filter by top-level category: Animations | Characters | Environments | GUI | Props | Vegetation | Vehicles. Note: 'Animations' is a small clip-pack category (a few hundred records) -- animated models mostly live in other categories. So animation/animations/animated/动画 in the query are understood as 'has animation' (is_animated=true) across all categories, and category=Animations with a keyword is also searched across categories; a keyword-less Animations browse stays exact. Plain category values are still exact matches.

image_url.description: Optional reference image for visual search (publicly reachable http(s) CDN URL; upload local files with file_upload first). The image is described by a multimodal model into controlled search terms and the library is searched (mode=image, separate rate limit and daily quota). Use when the user shows a picture instead of naming the object. When set, it takes precedence and 'query' is ignored -- pass 'query' only for keyword-only search without an image.

limit.description: Max models to return per call, 1-20 (default 5).

offset.description: Zero-based match index to page from. 0 (default) = start at the best match. Capped at 200: refine the query instead of paging deeper.

query.description: Search keywords: 2-3 core nouns, e.g. 'sci-fi mech', 'low poly tree', 'medieval house'. Avoid full sentences or long prompts. Optional when 'image_url' is provided.

session_id.description: Optional agent-injected session ID for grouping tasks.

sort.description: Result order: 'relevance' (default) or 'recent' (newest ingested first, by created_at -- use it with a broad keyword + category to browse the latest additions).

workspace_name.description: Optional agent-injected primary workspace directory name for grouping tasks.

functionDeclarations.name: search_my_assets
functionDeclarations.description:
Find reusable assets in the authenticated user's own completed generation history using Jev semantic matching. Searches across that user's sessions/workspaces and creation interfaces. Never searches other users, including for admins. Excludes deleted/discarded records, records without recognized output files, library purchases, standalone uploads and local project files. Shared catalogs use search_model_lib (platform models, the single 3D catalog). No user credits are charged.

Activation: Call this tool ONLY when the user explicitly asks to search/find/reuse their own previously generated assets, such as "search my generated assets" or "搜我以前生成的素材". General asset search/reuse, scene/game building, new generation requests, and "use existing assets" without an explicit personal-generation-history scope do not trigger it. Do not search personal history proactively or infer permission from the user's ownership, available history, project context or tool results. If the asset source is ambiguous, clarify it before calling this tool.

Single asset: pass query, optionally asset_types and top_k. With roles omitted, returns one group named "asset" with up to top_k candidates, including one selected record when a match is available.
Coordinated set: the calling agent decomposes the user's request into roles; query supplies shared scene/style constraints, and each role supplies a unique name, query and optional count. Roles are not inferred by this tool. count means distinct generation records, default 1, not scene instances: four copies of one chair need count=1, then four host-side instances. Files/formats within a record stay grouped. Pass all roles in one call. Example: {"query":"cozy wooden reading corner","asset_types":["3d"],"roles":[{"name":"seating","query":"wooden reading chair"},{"name":"table","query":"wooden side table"}],"top_k":5}.

Returns groups[].assets[] with task_id, name, asset_type, description, basis, score, optional preview_url and files[{url,format}]. groups[].selected_task_ids identifies the proposed distinct-record set; other candidates may overlap between roles. Use those IDs to pick the set, not simply the first candidate in every group. missing_count reports unfilled distinct-record slots. Scores are 0..3, not confidence percentages; only candidates scoring >=2 are returned. This judges metadata, not live appearance, file availability or layout: verify suitability before use.

Scans all eligible records in the request's catalog; top_k limits returned candidates only. complete describes scan completeness; set_complete additionally requires every role filled. Inspect warnings, scanned_count, total_eligible and failed_batches. Incomplete results or errors do not prove there are no matches. Report gaps and respect requests to reuse only the user's own assets; do not silently replace missing items with public assets or new generation.

Synchronous search: records one permanently free personal_asset_search task for usage statistics and returns search_task_id for that accounting record. It is hidden from Lab3D and generation history; it is not a new asset or an async job and needs no polling. Downloads nothing and does not import/place assets. groups[].assets[].task_id values refer to existing completed asset records. Use selected files[].url directly; never pass personal task IDs to download_model_lib. If extra asset details or import guides are needed, call check_task once with an asset task_id, regardless of its original creation interface. Neither search nor check_task guarantees renewal of expired file URLs. Explicit requests to generate new assets still use generation tools directly.

asset_types.description: Generation task categories to scan. Omit for all four; does not change ownership.

query.description: Asset to find, or shared scene/style requirements for a set.

roles.description: Optional roles supplied by the calling agent; up to 12. Omit for a single search. This tool does not invent roles.

count.description: Distinct generation records required for this role, default 1; not file count or scene instance count.

name.description: Unique role label within this request.

query.description: What this role must match, evaluated together with the shared query.

session_id.description: Optional caller context metadata, not a search filter.

top_k.description: Maximum returned candidates per role, default 5; raised to count when needed. Includes selected records. Does not limit scanning.

workspace_name.description: Optional caller context metadata, not a search filter; search covers all of the user's workspaces.

functionDeclarations.name: search_tts_voices
functionDeclarations.description: Find available speech voices by name or sound description; returns canonical IDs, formats, each voice's supported `emotions` and whether it accepts a free-form `emotionPrompt`. Free, no synthesis. Omit query to browse; use offset for pagination; pass emotion to keep only voices that accept it. catalog reports all public voices and provider/model availability; total counts matching available voices. Private clones: provider=fal. Use real IDs; never substitute named characters. Choose a match unless an exact named voice is unavailable or ambiguous. Style requests may go directly to generate_tts.voice_query.

emotion.description: Optional filter: keep only voices that support this emotion. Check a returned voice's `emotions` field (empty means the voice cannot change emotion).

language.description: Optional language, e.g. Chinese, English, Japanese; common codes zh/en/ja accepted.

provider.description: Optional filter: minimax/volc/qwen browse public voices; volc_voicelib is the Volc purchased voice library (e.g. 天津相声男声); fal lists only your own completed voice_clone results. Usually omit; choose by voice.

query.description: Voice name or sound description, e.g. 熊二 2.0 or mature warm English narrator. This is NOT the text to speak.

functionDeclarations.name: seedance_portrait_library
functionDeclarations.description: Manage the signed-in user's private virtual portraits, shared with Lab3D. The default and Qianfan libraries support Seedance 2.0 standard and 2.5. Qianfan portraits use a random seed. The RavenZone subject library supports all four Seedance models when available to Team subscribers. Use list or uploads, add a file using its uploaded URL, and use get to check live status. For an Active asset, pass its reference (or asset://<id> when reference is absent) in generate_video's matching media URL list.

id.description: Asset ID or the full reference for get or remove. Remove only when requested.

library.description: Select a subject library. Omit for the default portrait library.

name.description: Character name for add: 1–64 characters in the default library; 1–39 for RavenZone subjects.

page.description: 1-based page for list or uploads, 20 items per page.

page_only.description: For uploads, use true to browse indexed pages with hasMore. Omit for an exact totalCount.

url.description: For add, use a URL returned by uploads or your completed file_upload.

functionDeclarations.name: set_canvas_cover
functionDeclarations.description: 替换画布封面：提供已上传的 image_url，或 node_id 与可选 image_index 从图片节点选择产物。只更新封面，不覆盖节点和连线。

functionDeclarations.name: tripo_decimate
functionDeclarations.description: Reduce polygon count of a 3D model (high-poly to low-poly) using TripoAI. Defaults to retopology v3.0; quad output costs more than triangle output on v3.0. v2.0 smart retopo and v1.0 basic decimation (requires face_limit) remain selectable. smart_uv unwraps UVs during retopology and is v3.0-only; it does not produce a UV layout preview image — use a dedicated UV task for that. Input accepts ONE of: 'original_model_task_id' (a prior Tripo-only generate_3d_model task — NOT hunyuan/rodin) or 'url'. IMPORTANT: Tripo only recognizes its OWN task ids / file_token / a public model URL. If your source model came from hunyuan(混元)/Tencent/Rodin or any non-Tripo provider, you CANNOT pass its task id — use 'url' instead. You MUST first download/export the model file and upload it with the file_upload tool to get a CDN URL, then pass that URL as 'url'. Same applies to local model files (use file_upload to upload and get a CDN URL). Async: returns task_id and shell poll metadata. Follow the task result's ONE-background-subagent wait instructions at poll_interval_seconds, then check_task once.

face_limit.description: Target face count. v3.0/v2.0: 500–20000 triangles, 500–10000 quads (optional, auto when omitted); v1.0 requires it.

model.description: Retopology algorithm. v3.0 (default) supports smart_uv and quad; v2.0 smart retopo; v1.0 basic decimation requires face_limit. Omit for v3.0.

original_model_task_id.description: Task ID of a prior Tripo generate_3d_model task. Only valid when the source is Tripo-generated (not hunyuan/Rodin). Required if 'url' is not provided.

quad.description: Output quad mesh (optional, default false). Costs more than triangle output on v3.0.

session_id.description: Optional agent-injected session ID for grouping tasks.

smart_uv.description: v3.0 only: unwrap UVs during retopology (no extra charge, no UV preview image). Passing true with v1.0/v2.0 is rejected.

url.description: Direct public model file URL (e.g. from file_upload) — REQUIRED for hunyuan/Rodin/non-Tripo source models and local files. Required if 'original_model_task_id' is not provided.

with_fbx.description: Whether to convert the result to FBX format after completion (default true)

workspace_name.description: Optional agent-injected primary workspace directory name for grouping tasks.

functionDeclarations.name: tripo_mesh_segmentation
functionDeclarations.description: Segment a 3D model into semantic parts using TripoAI. Input accepts ONE of: 'original_model_task_id' (a prior Tripo-only generate_3d_model task — NOT hunyuan/rodin) or 'url'. IMPORTANT: Tripo only recognizes its OWN task ids / file_token / a public model URL. If your source model came from hunyuan(混元)/Tencent/Rodin or any non-Tripo provider, you CANNOT pass its task id — its id is a provider-specific jobId Tripo rejects. You MUST first download/export the model file and upload it with the file_upload tool to get a CDN URL, then pass that URL as 'url'. Same applies to local model files (use file_upload to upload and get a CDN URL). Async: returns task_id and shell poll metadata. Follow the task result's ONE-background-subagent wait instructions at poll_interval_seconds, then check_task once.

model_version.description: Tripo model version for the /mesh/segment endpoint (optional). Only 'v1.0-20250506' or 'v2.0-20260430' are accepted — generation-only versions like 'P1-20260311'/'v3.1-20260211' (H3.1) are REJECTED by Tripo with a 400. Leave empty to use the default (v2.0-20260430, semantic segmentation).

## 一、先分清楚「配置」的四个层次

关卡制游戏最容易犯的错是把所有东西塞进一个「关卡配置」。规范的做法是分四层，每层职责单一：

| 层次 | 内容 | 变更频率 | 载体 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 全局静态配置 | 数值表、成长曲线、掉落表、奖励表 | 低 | ScriptableObject / 导表 |
| 关卡索引表 | 有哪些关卡、章节归属、顺序、解锁条件 | 中 | 一个 `LevelTable` 资产 |
| **单关卡配置** | 一关的目标、失败条件、难度覆写、奖励、场景 | **高（策划天天改）** | 一关一个 `.asset` |
| 表现与资源绑定 | 场景、预制体、BGM、教学步骤、文本 key | 中 | 引用字段 + 文本表 |

关键原则：**索引与内容分离**。`LevelTable` 只存 `levelId` 列表和章节结构，不存关卡参数；关卡参数在各自的 LevelConfig 里。这样索引表不会因为改数值产生冲突，也天然支持「关卡包」按章节分块加载。

## 二、单关卡配置的标准字段分组

一个规范的 LevelConfig 应该按这几组划分（字段名带前缀避免 Unity Inspector 里混淆）：

1. **标识组**：`levelId`（全局唯一、永久不变）、`schemaVersion`（结构版本，用于将来迁移）、`displayOrder`、`levelKind`（玩法类型枚举）、`enabled`（下线开关）
2. **解锁组**：`requiredLevelIds[]`（前置关卡）+ `unlockCondition`（星级/货币等条件）
3. **目标组**：`goals[]` —— **可组合条件列表**，达成即胜利
4. **失败组**：`failRules[]` —— 同样可组合
5. **难度组**：`baseProfile`（引用公共难度模板）+ `overrides[]`（**只写与本关不同的值**）
6. **奖励组**：`rewards[]`，用 `rewardId` 引用奖励表，不内联数值
7. **表现组**：`scene`、`bgm`、`tutorial[]`

其中最关键的两条设计约定：

**① 目标/失败用「条件对象」，不要一关写一个 if**

```csharp
[Serializable]
public struct LevelGoal
{
    public GoalType type;   // ReachScore / SurviveTime / ClearCount / NoMiss / CollectCount ...
    public string key;      // 统计项标识，解耦玩法实现
    public CompareOp op;    // >=, ==, <=
    public float target;    // 目标值
}

[Serializable]
public struct LevelFailRule
{
    public FailType type;   // TimeUp / MissTooMany / PlayerDead
    public float threshold;
}
```

玩法代码只做一件事：把运行时统计写进一个 `Dictionary<string,float>`，然后让一个通用的 `ConditionEvaluator` 去比对配置。新增关卡永远不会新增代码。

**② 参数分层覆写，不要复制粘贴**

难度参数（杯子数量、移动速度、干扰强度…）放在 `DifficultyProfile` 这种公共模板资产里，单关配置只填 `ParamOverride { key, value }` 的差异项。好处是策划调平衡时改模板能一次性生效，且极易看出「这关和模板差在哪」。

## 三、`levelId` 与版本规范

- **ID 一旦发布就永久冻结**。存档只存 `levelId`（+ 星级/进度），改 ID 等于清档。
- 推荐 `章节-序号` 格式：`1-03`、`2-11`；内部再加一个不可见的 `uid`（GUID）用于重命名时保持存档兼容。
- 每次给 SO 加/删/改字段语义时 `schemaVersion++`，写一个 `LevelConfigMigrator` 读取时按版本号补齐默认值——这是长线项目的必备保险。

## 四、目录与命名规范

```
Assets/
├── GameData/
│   ├── Settings/            # 全局配置
│   │   ├── LevelTable.asset
│   │   └── DifficultyProfile_Normal.asset
│   ├── Levels/
│   │   ├── Chapter01/
│   │   │   ├── Level_1-01.asset
│   │   │   └── Level_1-02.asset
│   │   └── Chapter02/
│   └── Text/                # 多语言 key 表
├── Scripts/
│   ├── Config/              # 数据结构定义（SO + 枚举 + 条件）
│   ├── Runtime/             # 玩法实现
│   └── Editor/              # 校验与工具
└── Scenes/
    └── Levels/
```

命名统一 `Level_<章节>-<序号>.asset`，配合 `[CreateAssetMenu(fileName = "Level_")]`，新建时自动带前缀。

如果关卡量超过 ~100 关、或需要策划脱离 Unity 改数值，就该把单关配置改成 **Excel/CSV 导表**（一个 sheet 一行一关，构建时生成 SO 或二进制包）。决策标准：**关卡参数改动频率 × 策划是否进 Unity**。100 关以内、快速验证阶段，SO 更灵活；正式运营的数值型关卡，导表更稳。

## 五、「关卡配置包」的另一层含义：资源包

如果你说的「配置包」是指把一整个章节的关卡资源打成一个可增量下载的包，那是 Addressables 的职责，做法是：

- 每个章节一个 Group（`Chapter01_Levels`），Group 里放该章的 LevelConfig、场景、预制体、音频
- `LevelTable` 里每关记录它所属的 `packKey`，进入关卡前 `Addressables.LoadAssetAsync<LevelConfig>(packKey)`
- 好处：首包小、后续章节热更、加载粒度与章节对齐

配置（文本/数值）与资源（美术/音频）建议分两个 Group，避免改一行数值就要重下美术包。

## 六、必须配的工具：校验器

这是「规范」能不能真正落地的关键。在 `Assets/Scripts/Editor/` 放一个批量校验菜单（`Tools/GameData/Validate Levels`），跑一遍检查：

- `levelId` 全表唯一、非空、符合命名正则
- 所有 `requiredLevelIds` / `rewardId` / `scene` 引用存在且未丢失
- 必填字段非空、`goals` 至少一条
- `LevelTable` 里每个 ID 都能找到对应资产，反之亦然
- 覆写的 `key` 在 `baseProfile` 中存在

CI 或每次提交前跑一次，能挡掉 80% 的线上事故（空配置、错 ID、丢引用）。

## 七、常见坑

1. **改 `levelId` 导致存档失效** —— 用内部 uid 兜底
2. **数值硬编码进 Prefab/场景** —— 所有可调数值必须来自配置，否则「调平衡」等于改场景
3. **单关 SO 里内联奖励数值** —— 应引用奖励表，便于全局调价
4. **覆写不可追踪** —— 提供 Editor 按钮「Diff 与模板对比」，让策划看到自己偏离了多少
5. **配置和代码同版本耦合** —— 加 `schemaVersion` + 迁移器

| 配置资产 | 数量 | 作用 | 是否必需 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LevelCatalog` | 1 个 | 记录有哪些关卡、按什么顺序列在选关界面 | 必需（否则程序不知道有多少关） |
| `LevelConfig` | 每关 1 个 | 该关的玩法参数 + 胜负条件 + 场景/表现 | 必需，核心 |
| `GlobalTuning` | 0~1 个 | 所有关共用、且将来可能整体微调的常量 | 可选，**默认不要建** |

## 二、单关卡配置放什么

只剩四组字段，且都很直白：

1. **标识**：`levelId`（唯一、稳定）、`displayName`、`enabled`
2. **玩法参数**：这一关到底怎么玩——就是你玩法里那几个旋钮（杯子数量、移动速度、轮数、观察时长……）。**所有关卡间的差异只能出现在这里**
3. **胜负条件**：成功条件（必需）、失败条件（可选，比如超时）
4. **场景与表现**：场景引用、BGM、引导提示

```csharp
[CreateAssetMenu(menuName = "GameData/Level Config", fileName = "Level_")]
public sealed class LevelConfig : ScriptableObject
{
    [Header("标识")]
    [SerializeField] string levelId;        // "L001"，发布后冻结
    [SerializeField] string displayName;
    [SerializeField] bool enabled = true;

    [Header("玩法参数")]
    [SerializeField] int cupCount = 3;      // ↓ 这些是玩法旋钮，按你的玩法替换
    [SerializeField] float shuffleSpeed = 1f;
    [SerializeField] int roundCount = 5;

    [Header("胜负条件")]
    [SerializeField] int requiredCorrect = 3;   // 成功条件
    [SerializeField] float timeLimit = 60f;     // <=0 表示不限时

    [Header("场景与表现")]
    [SerializeField] SceneReference scene;
    [SerializeField] AudioClip bgm;
    [SerializeField] string tutorialKey;        // 文本走 key，别硬编码中文

    public string LevelId => levelId;
    public int CupCount => cupCount;
    // ... 其余只读属性
}
```

参数模型有个分水岭要注意：**如果全游戏只有一种玩法机制**，就用上面这种强类型字段；**只有当你以后要加第二种完全不同的玩法**（比如从猜球变成消除），才改成「key-value 参数表 + 玩法类型枚举」。现在不要提前抽象，那会让每一关的配置都变成难读的字典。

```csharp
public sealed class LevelCatalog : ScriptableObject
{
    [SerializeField] List<LevelConfig> levels;   // 顺即选关界面的展示顺序
    public IReadOnlyList<LevelConfig> Levels => levels;
}
```

## 三、脚本怎么安排

核心原则：**关卡之间独立 ⇒ 一关一个运行时会话对象，无全局常驻状态**。不要写一个常驻的 `GameManager` 持有当前关卡进度，那会把「独立关卡」重新耦合成一条链。

```
Assets/Scripts/
├── Config/                      # 纯数据，零逻辑
│   ├── LevelConfig.cs           # SO：单关参数
│   ├── LevelCatalog.cs          # SO：关卡总表
│   └── LevelState.cs            # enum: Loading / Ready / Playing / Ended
├── Flow/                        # 关卡生命周期
│   ├── LevelSession.cs          # 单关的唯一入口，创建即开始，结束即销毁
│   ├── LevelLoader.cs           # 读配置 + 加载场景 + 注入参数
│   └── ConditionEvaluator.cs    # 判定成功/失败
├── Gameplay/                    # 玩法规则，不含表现
│   ├── GameRules.cs             # 从 LevelConfig 取参数，驱动玩法
│   └── CupController.cs         # 玩法实体（按你的名字改）
├── Presentation/                # 只订阅、不改规则
│   ├── LevelHud.cs              # 剩余轮数/计时
│   └── ResultPanel.cs           # 结算 + 返回选关
├── Services/
│   ├── ProgressStore.cs         # 只记录"已通关 levelId 集合"，给选关界面打勾
│   └── AudioService.cs
└── Editor/
    ├── LevelConfigValidator.cs  # 一键校验：id 唯一、引用不丢、参数合法
    └── LevelConfigCreator.cs    # 新建关卡时自动套模板、自动登记进 Catalog
```

生命周期是这样的（这就是为什么不需要全局管理器）：

```
LevelCatalog ──(玩家选关)──> LevelSession.Create(config)
                                   │
                          LevelLoader: 加载场景 + 校验参数
                                   │
                          GameRules: 用 config 的参数初始化
                                   │
                          Playing → ConditionEvaluator 每帧/每回合判定
                                   │
                          Ended → ResultPanel 展示 → ProgressStore 记录 → 销毁 Session
```

```csharp
public sealed class LevelSession : MonoBehaviour
{
    LevelConfig config;
    LevelState state;

    public static LevelSession Create(LevelConfig cfg) { /* 实例化 + 注入 */ }

    void Begin()
    {
        if (!ConditionEvaluator.Validate(config, out var err)) { /* 配置错误直接报 */ }
        state = LevelState.Playing;
        rules.Setup(config);           // 唯一一次把配置喂给玩法的地方
    }

    void Update()
    {
        if (state != LevelState.Playing) return;
        if (ConditionEvaluator.IsWin(config, rules.Stats))  End(true);
        else if (ConditionEvaluator.IsFail(config, rules.Stats)) End(false);
    }

    void End(bool win)
    {
        state = LevelState.Ended;
        if (win) ProgressStore.MarkCleared(config.LevelId);
        // 通知表现层，然后销毁自身
    }
}
```

新增第 100 关时，**代码改动量为 0**：新建一个 asset、在 Catalog 里拖进去。这就是这套安排要守住的东西。

## 四、两个容易被忽略但必须配的

1. **文本不要硬编码**：`displayName`、引导语都走 key（哪怕是单语言，也用一张 Text 表或 SO），否则将来改文案要动资产、做多语言要翻全工程。
2. **`ProgressStore` 仍然值得保留**：虽然没有解锁逻辑，但选关界面通常要显示「已通关」。只存 `HashSet<string> clearedLevelIds`，和配置完全解耦，`levelId` 冻结的规则依然适用（改 id = 丢记录）。

## 五、配置资产的存放

没有章节了，就一维放平，别过度分层：

```
Assets/GameData/
├── LevelCatalog.asset
└── Levels/
    ├── Level_L001.asset
    ├── Level_L002.asset
    └── ...
```

配上 `LevelConfigCreator`：新建时自动生成 `Level_L0xx` 文件名、自动写入 `levelId`、自动 append 到 `LevelCatalog`，可以消除「忘记登记」这个最常见的配置事故。

---

要我在工程里把这一套搭出来吗？我会建好 `Scripts/Config`、`Flow`、`Gameplay`、`Presentation`、`Services` 的骨架代码、`LevelCatalog` 和一个示例 `Level_L001`，再加那个自动登记 + 校验的编辑器工具。动手前只需要你确认一件事：**玩法机制是什么**（项目名像是三仙归洞/猜球，如果是，我就按「杯子数 / 移动速度 / 轮数 / 正确次数 / 限时」来定字段；如果是别的玩法，告诉我那几个旋钮是什么）。

工程现状先摆清楚，后面的建议都基于这个：

- `com.unity.feature.2d` 2.0.1 + URP 14.0.12，且 `Assets/Settings/Renderer2D.asset` 已配置为 2D Renderer → Tilemap、Sprite Mask、2D 光照都能直接用
- **没有装 `com.unity.inputsystem`**（新输入系统），所以输入目前只能走旧版 `Input` 类，或先装包
- 没有 Addressables → 关卡"包"其实就是场景，不需要额外的包管理，省一层复杂度
- `Assets/Scripts` 仍为空

## 一、先写什么：先写一个灰盒垂直切片，而不是先写配置系统

我上一轮给的配置骨架方向没错，但**顺序要反过来**。你现在最大的风险不是"配置写得不规范"，而是**「大部分画面被遮住」这个核心机制到底好不好玩、视窗多大才看得懂路**。这个东西如果手感不对，配置系统做得再规整也是白搭。所以：

### 阶段 0：灰盒原型（半天到一天，全部硬编码，不写任何配置）

一个场景里放这些：

1. 一张 Tilemap 地形（墙 + 路），左右各一份
2. 左右半屏各一个**白色方块**当角色
3. 每半屏一层不透明遮盖
4. 两个跟随各自角色的矩形视窗（在遮盖层上"挖洞"）
5. 一个传送门 Trigger，进入即 `Debug.Log("通关")`

**做完就地能玩，判定标准只有一个：你自己玩两分钟，能不能靠两个视窗拼出路线。**

视窗的实现方式建议这轮就定下来，三种方案：

| 方案 | 做法 | 优点 | 缺点 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Sprite Mask** | 遮盖层 Sprite 设 `Visible Outside Mask`，再用一个矩形 `SpriteMask` 跟随角色 | 最快、零 shader、URP 下最稳 | 边缘只能硬切，难柔化 |
| 自定义 Shader | 遮罩图里挖矩形，`smoothstep` 做羽化 | 性能最好，可做柔边、扫描线、渐晕 | 要写 shader，调试慢 |
| 相机 + RenderTexture | 视窗内再用一台相机渲染到 RT | 能做缩放/畸变/画中画 | 开销最大，层级最复杂 |

**原型用 Sprite Mask，定稿大概率换 Shader**。先别为了"将来可能柔化"提前上 shader。

### 阶段 1：输入抽象与双角色控制

```csharp
public interface IControlScheme
{
    void Tick();                        // 每帧决定谁吃输入
    bool IsActive(PlayerSide side);     // 当前主控方
}
```

- `SinglePlayerScheme`：鼠标左键点击 → 切换 `activeSide`，随时可切
- `TwoPlayerScheme`：左角色 WASD、右角色方向键，两个同时接收，没有 `activeSide` 概念

关键设计约束：**切换主控只能改变"谁接收输入"，绝不能改变画面渲染**。一旦渲染层也跟主控联动，后面双人模式会彻底对不上，这是这类游戏最容易埋的坑。

### 阶段 2：才做数据化

把阶段 0 里硬编码的东西搬进 `LevelConfig`，加 `LevelCatalog` 和选关界面，再套 `LevelSession` 流程。

### 阶段 3：表现打磨（视窗跟随平滑、传送门动画、音效）

## 二、现在还需要配置的东西

比上一轮精简了一大截，只剩这些：

| 配置 | 内容 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|
| `GameTuning`（全局 1 份） | 移速/加速度（若跳跃则含重力、跳跃力）、视窗**默认**尺寸、跟随平滑系数、未探索区域暗度、左右半屏比例 | 只有"所有关共用且可能整体调"的值才放这里 |
| `LevelConfig`（每关 1 份） | `levelId`、显示名、**支持模式**（单人/双人/两者）、地图引用、左右**出生点**、传送门位置 + 触发半径、视窗尺寸（可选覆写）、`enabled` | 关与关独立，没有任何互相引用 |
| `LevelCatalog`（1 份） | 关卡列表，即选关界面顺序 | 只存引用，不存参数 |
| 文本表（1 份） | 关卡名、引导提示的 key | 哪怕单语言也建议做，成本极低 |

**明确不需要建的**：`DifficultyProfile`、`UnlockCondition`、`RewardTable`、章节/关卡组、成长曲线。上一轮的 `ProgressStore` 降级为可选——如果选关界面要显示"已通关"就打勾，不需要就整块删掉。

还有一点容易被当成配置、其实要单独想清楚的：**遮盖层从哪来**。两个做法决定了完全不同的架构——

- **A. 程序自动铺满遮盖**：每个半屏盖一张不透明层，视窗是唯一可见处。实现最省事，但玩家走过的地方也不会记住，每次都要靠视窗重新摸索
- **B. 手绘/生成的遮蔽区域**：可以留出"已知区域"，形成探索记忆感。需要在关卡里额外维护一份"可见性掩码"

如果选 B，`LevelConfig` 就要多一个 `revealMask` 字段，而且关卡编辑工作量翻倍。这个需要你定。

## 三、几个次要但会影响脚本结构的问题

1. **视窗尺寸**是全局固定，还是允许逐关不同（我做成了可选覆写）？边缘硬切还是要柔化？
2. **是否有失败条件**（掉坑、限时、被发现）？还是"只有通关，没有失败"？
3. **双人模式下还保留视窗吗**？如果两名玩家各自盯自己那半屏，视窗机制在双人模式可能就没意义了——这会改变双人模式的实现分支
4. **角色能走出各自半屏吗**？相机跟随，还是地图就等于半屏大小、角色永远在半屏内活动？
5. **单人切换主控有没有代价**（冷却、切换耗时、切换瞬间不能移动）？如果切换是完全免费即时的，"什么时候切"就没有决策性，玩起来会变成左右无脑乱点

## 四、必须先确认的 4 件事

这几个直接决定渲染架构和脚本结构，我不猜：

messages.content:
你选的「同一张地图的同一画面」让实现简单了很多——**不需要分屏相机**，一台正交相机拍一张完整地图，左右只是视觉上的分区约定。但「视框揭示的是视框自身所覆盖的区域」这条，推出来一个很关键的玩法约束，我先跟你对一遍。

## 一、先确认我对机制的理解

```
┌───────────────────┬───────────────────┐
│ 左半屏             │ 右半屏             │
│                   │                   │
│  ■ 左角色          │  □ 左角色的视窗     │  ← 露出右半屏这块的真实地形
│                   │        ■ 右角色    │
│  □ 右角色的视窗     │                   │  ← 露出左半屏这块的真实地形
│                   │                   │
└───────────────────┴───────────────────┘
        整个画面被遮盖层盖住，只有两个口子能看见地形
```

由此推出三点，如果和你想的不一样要立刻纠正我，因为实现完全建在这上面：

1. **视窗位置 = 角色位置水平平移一个半屏宽**。左角色往右走 1 格，它在右半屏的视窗也往右 1 格。
2. **你永远看不清自己脚下，只能看清队友前方的路**。左角色走到哪、前方有没有坑，靠的是「右角色的视窗」划到哪里。
3. **所以两人必须保持在水平方向上大致对齐（相差半屏），才能互相照见**。这条天然产生了一个稳定的核心循环：

> 切到 A → 把 A 移到刚好能照见 B 前方的位置 → 切回 B 前进几步 → 再切到 A 重新对位

如果这个循环成立，那这个游戏的核心乐趣是「**用控制位置来换取视野，而控制位置本身又是要冒险的**」——这是个很紧的设计，值得保留。

## 二、这个机制带来的两个硬实现约束

**① 千万别用两台相机分屏。** 一体化画面下，两个角色就是同一个场景里的两个世界对象，`x = 0` 处放一个视觉分隔线即可。用分屏相机会让「平移映射」和 `SpriteMask` 全部变复杂，而且对不上。

**② 别用 `Input.GetAxis("Horizontal")`。** 旧输入系统的轴是全局的，`Horizontal` 同时包含了 A/D 和 ←/→，两个角色会读到同一份输入、按键串味。必须直接读 `KeyCode`：

```csharp
// 左角色
float x = (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.D) ? 1 : 0) - (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.A) ? 1 : 0);
// 右角色
float x2 = (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.RightArrow) ? 1 : 0) - (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.LeftArrow) ? 1 : 0);
```

这条路零配置就能跑；如果以后要接手柄双人，再装 `com.unity.inputsystem`（现在工程没装）。

## 三、现在先写什么

按依赖顺序，一共 6 个脚本，第一个场景能跑起来之前不要碰配置系统：

| 顺序 | 文件 | 职责 | 关键点 |
|---|---|---|---|

```csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ThreeCup.GrayBox
{
    [RequireComponent(typeof(Rigidbody2D))]
    public sealed class PlayerMotor2D : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [SerializeField] PlayerSide side = PlayerSide.Left;
        [SerializeField] float moveSpeed = 7f;
        [SerializeField] float jumpVelocity = 12f;
        [SerializeField] float fallRespawnY = -6f;
        [SerializeField] LayerMask groundMask = ~0;

        Rigidbody2D body;
        InputRouter router;
        Vector2 safePoint;
        float horizontal;
        bool jumpQueued;
        bool grounded;

        public PlayerSide Side => side;
        public bool Grounded => grounded;

        void Awake()
        {
            body = GetComponent<Rigidbody2D>();
            safePoint = transform.position;
        }

        void Update()
        {
            router ??= FindObjectOfType<InputRouter>();
            if (router != null)
            {
                horizontal = router.GetHorizontal(side);
                if (router.GetJumpDown(side)) jumpQueued = true;
            }
        }

        void FixedUpdate()
        {
            var v = body.velocity;
            v.x = horizontal * moveSpeed;
            if (jumpQueued && grounded) { v.y = jumpVelocity; }
            jumpQueued = false;
            body.velocity = v;

            grounded = CheckGround();
            if (grounded && Mathf.Abs(v.y) < 0.5f) safePoint = transform.position;

            if (transform.position.y < fallRespawnY) Respawn();
        }

        bool CheckGround()
        {
            var b = GetComponent<Collider2D>().bounds;
            var origin = new Vector2(b.center.x, b.min.y + 0.02f);
            return Physics2D.Raycast(origin, Vector2.down, 0.12f, groundMask) ||
                   Physics2D.Raycast(new Vector2(b.min.x + 0.05f, origin.y), Vector2.down, 0.12f, groundMask) ||
                   Physics2D.Raycast(new Vector2(b.max.x - 0.05f, origin.y), Vector2.down, 0.12f, groundMask);
        }

        void Respawn()
        {
            body.velocity = Vector2.zero;
            body.position = safePoint;
            transform.position = safePoint;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace ThreeCup.GrayBox
{
    public enum ControlMode { SinglePlayer, TwoPlayer }

    public sealed class InputRouter : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [SerializeField] ControlMode mode = ControlMode.SinglePlayer;
        [SerializeField] PlayerSide activeSide = PlayerSide.Left;

        public ControlMode Mode => mode;
        public PlayerSide ActiveSide => activeSide;

        void Update()
        {
            if (mode == ControlMode.SinglePlayer && Input.GetMouseButtonDown(0))
                activeSide = activeSide == PlayerSide.Left ? PlayerSide.Right : PlayerSide.Left;
        }

        public bool IsControlled(PlayerSide side) =>
            mode == ControlMode.TwoPlayer || side == activeSide;

        public float GetHorizontal(PlayerSide side)
        {
            if (!IsControlled(side)) return 0f;

            if (mode == ControlMode.TwoPlayer)
            {
                return side == PlayerSide.Left
                    ? (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.D) ? 1f : 0f) - (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.A) ? 1f : 0f)
                    : (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.RightArrow) ? 1f : 0f) - (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.LeftArrow) ? 1f : 0f);
            }

            // Single player: only one character is active, so both key sets are available.
            float x = (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.D) || Input.GetKey(KeyCode.RightArrow) ? 1f : 0f)
                    - (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.A) || Input.GetKey(KeyCode.LeftArrow) ? 1f : 0f);
            return x;
        }

        public bool GetJumpDown(PlayerSide side)
        {
            if (!IsControlled(side)) return false;

            if (mode == ControlMode.TwoPlayer)
            {
                return side == PlayerSide.Left
                    ? Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.W)
                    : Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.UpArrow);
            }

            return Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.W) || Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.UpArrow) || Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Space);
        }
    }
}
```

messages.content:
阶段 0 搭完了，已验证通过。

**先说一个偏差**：你给的上下文指向 `Assets/Scenes/SampleScene 1.unity`，但磁盘上只有 `SampleScene.unity` 和 `LHJ_TestScene.unity`，没有前者。`LHJ_TestScene.unity` 是当时打开的空场景（只有 Main Camera + Global Light 2D），我就搭在里面了。如果你本意是另一个场景，告诉我，我可以整体搬过去。

## 已经有的东西

**脚本** `Assets/Scripts/GrayBox/`（命名空间 `ThreeCup.GrayBox`）

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `PlayerSide.cs` | `PlayerSide` / `ControlMode` 枚举 |
| `PlayerMotor2D` | 平台跳跃 + 掉坑重生到最近安全点 |
| `InputRouter` | 唯一的输入入口，单人点击切换 / 双人分键 |
| `VisionWindow` | 视窗跟随 owner，`offset` 每个窗口独立配置 |
| `Portal` | 按 side 判定占用 |
| `WinChecker` | 两端同时在场 N 秒通关 |
| `PlayerVisual` | 非主控角色变灰 |

**资源**：`Assets/Art/GrayBox/White4x4.png`（1×1 世界单位的纯白 sprite）+ `PlayerNoFriction` 物理材质。

**场景** `LHJ_TestScene.unity`：

```
GrayBox
├── Terrain        Plat_L1 / Plat_L2 / Plat_R1 / Plat_R2   （y=-3 平台，两处 1 格坑）
├── Portals        Portal_Left(x=-1) / Portal_Right(x=1)
├── Players        Player_Left(-6.5) / Player_Right(6.5)
├── Vision         Fog（order 10, VisibleOutsideMask）
│                  Window_OfLeftChar（mask, offset +8, 4×3）
│                  Window_OfRightChar（mask, offset -8, 4×3）
└── Managers       InputRouter / WinChecker
```

正交相机 size 4.5 → 16:9 下世界宽 16，半屏宽 8。排序：地形 0 < 传送门 5 < 遮盖 10 < 角色 20。

## 验证结果（离屏渲染采样像素，不是肉眼判断）

| 检查项 | 实测 |
|---|---|
| 左角色视窗内看到地形 | `(0.42,0.45,0.52)` = 平台色 ✓ |
| 右角色视窗内看到地形 | `(0.42,0.45,0.52)` = 平台色 ✓ |
| 视窗之外的地形 | `(0.05,0.05,0.05)` = 几乎全黑，地形被完全遮住 ✓ |
| 角色本体 | `(0.35,0.75,1.00)` = 角色色，在遮盖之上 ✓ |
| 视窗跟随 | 角色 x=-5.0 → 视窗 x=3.00（= -5+8）✓ |
| 掉坑重生 | 计数 0→1，回到 `(-6.50,-2.59)` 安全点 ✓ |
| 单人模式切换 | 主控左 → 只有 L 接收；主控右 → 只有 R 接收 ✓ |
| 双人模式 | 两侧同时接收 ✓ |
| 通关判定 | 两人同时进门后 held 累计到 0.502 → `Completed=True` ✓ |

## 现在可以直接按 Play 试手感

- **单人**：鼠标左键切换主控，A/D 或 ←/→ 移动，W / ↑ / 空格 跳
- **双人**：左角色 A/D + W，右角色 ←/→ + ↑
- 想切模式改 `Managers` 上的 `InputRouter.mode`

可调参数：`PlayerMotor2D` 的 `moveSpeed`(5.5) / `jumpVelocity`(10.5) / 角色 `Rigidbody2D.gravityScale`(3) / `fallRespawnY`(-6)；窗口大小改两个 Window 的 `localScale`(4×3)；窗口偏移改 `VisionWindow.offset`（这就是你要的「独立调整」）；遮盖色改 `Fog` 的 SpriteRenderer color；通关时间改 `WinChecker.requiredSeconds`(0.5)。

## 实现思路

1. **不建分屏相机**。既然是一张图拆两半，就是一台正交相机拍完整地图，左右只是坐标约定（`x<0` 左、`x>0` 右）。这样两个角色、两套视窗都在同一个坐标系里，省掉了双相机同步的全部麻烦。
2. **遮盖用 SpriteMask，不用 shader**。`Fog` 是一张覆盖全屏的不透明 Sprite，`maskInteraction = VisibleOutsideMask`；两个 `SpriteMask` 对象当作「洞」，通过 `isCustomRangeActive + front/backOrder 0..100` 把遮挡范围精确限定在 Fog 上（排序 10 在区间内，角色 20 不在，所以角色不会被挖掉——实际上角色用的是 `maskInteraction = None`，双重保险）。这是纯色灰盒阶段成本最低的方案，等你觉得边缘太硬、想要羽化时再换 shader。
3. **视窗位置 = owner + offset**，offset 是 `VisionWindow` 上的可序列化字段，所以左右两侧不强制镜像（你要的 5.1）。`OnValidate` 里也会刷新，所以在编辑器里拖角色能直接看到窗口跟着动。

7. **掉坑重生记录「最后一次站稳的位置」**，而不是固定出生点——所以掉进中间的坑会回到坑边，而不是被扔回关卡起点。
8. **验证方式**：把相机渲染到 RenderTexture，再 `ReadPixels` 采样已知世界坐标的像素颜色，直接判断「视窗内是不是平台色、视窗外是不是遮盖色」。这比截图靠肉眼可靠，也不依赖 Game View 分辨率。

- 掉坑重生是瞬间传送，没有延迟和无敌帧，可能感觉突兀
- 没有配置系统、没有选关、没有美术

四项改动都完成并验证通过。

## 改动与结果

| 需求 | 做法 | 实测 |
|---|---|---|
| 角色限制在半屏 | 左右各加一堵边界墙（x=±8.2），中央墙挡在 x=0 | 左角色推右停在 `-0.56`、推左停在 `-7.59`；右角色推左停在 `0.56`、推右停在 `7.59` ✓ |
| 背景与遮盖层上色 | 相机背景 `(0.07,0.16,0.22)` 深蓝绿；遮盖层 `(0.19,0.12,0.30)` 紫罗兰 | 视窗内天空采样 `(0.07,0.16,0.22)`、视窗外 `(0.20,0.11,0.30)`、遮盖下的平台读出的是遮盖色 ✓ |
| 屏幕中间的墙 | `Wall_Center`，0.3 宽、12 高，石色 `(0.55,0.47,0.45)`，排序 15 | 采样 `(0.55,0.47,0.45)` ✓ |
| 点击到角色才切换 | `Collider2D.OverlapPoint` 逐个测角色碰撞盒 | 点左角色→切到 Left；点右角色→切到 Right；点空地/点角色上方→**不切换** ✓ |

## 实现要点

**中央墙放在遮盖层之上（order 15）**，而不是当普通地形盖住。它要同时干两件事：阻挡移动、告诉玩家「这里是分界」。如果按地形放在 order 0，玩家会撞上一堵看不见的墙，体验很差。角色在 order 20，仍在墙之上，不会被挡。

**两侧边界墙留在地形层（order 0）**，被遮盖盖住 —— 因为那里是屏幕边缘，露出来只是多余的亮条。代价是角色滑到边缘时撞的是隐形墙。如果你觉得别扭，把这两个 `SpriteRenderer` 的 sortingOrder 改成 15 就变成可见的了。

**点击选中没有用 `Physics2D.OverlapPoint`**，而是让每个角色在 `Start` 里把自己注册进 `InputRouter` 的列表，然后逐个 `Collider2D.OverlapPoint` 测试。原因：`Physics2D.OverlapPoint` 只返回一个碰撞体，会被触发器（传送门）和层级干扰，而这里我们要精确回答「这个角色被点到了吗」。`TrySelectAt(Vector2)` 是公开方法，以后接触摸或手柄光标的点击逻辑可以直接复用。

**限制用的是物理墙而不是钳制坐标**。钳制会跟跳跃、重力打架（角色跳起来还能穿过去），墙体则天然和物理系统一致，也不必每帧写位置。

## 一个需要你定的细节

视窗 offset 是 ±8，而半屏宽正好也是 8。角色被墙限制后，x 只能在 `[-7.59, -0.56]`，对应视窗中心在 `[0.41, 7.44]`，窗口半边宽 2 —— 所以当角色贴在最左端时，窗口会往中央墙左边多伸出去约 1.6 个单位，露出一小条**本侧**地形。

不算致命（露的是靠近中央的位置），但确实是个信息泄漏。两个解法：把 `offset` 调成 ±8.5，或把窗口宽度从 4 收到 3.5。我没擅自改，因为你说过偏移要能独立调。

按你的要求停在这里，等你试手感。

messages.content:
视窗没有用第二台相机，也没有做 RenderTexture 或贴图拷贝。它的本质很朴素：整屏盖一层不透明色块，然后在色块上挖两个可以移动的洞。

## 三层结构

```
排序 20  角色      ← 在遮盖之上，永远可见
排序 15  中央墙    ← 在遮盖之上，作为分隔线
排序 10  遮盖层 Fog  ← 不透明紫罗兰色，盖住整屏（24×14）
排序  5  传送门
排序  0  地形平台  ← 被 Fog 完全挡住
```

角色能看见，是因为它画在遮盖层上面；地形看不见，是因为它画在遮盖层下面。这个游戏里「看得见/看不见」完全由排序决定，跟相机没关系。

## 遮盖层是怎么被"挖洞"的

`Fog` 是一个普通 `SpriteRenderer`，只改了一个属性：

```csharp
fogSr.maskInteraction = SpriteMaskInteraction.VisibleOutsideMask;
```

`VisibleOutsideMask` 的含义是：**这张图只渲染在"没有被任何 SpriteMask 覆盖"的像素上**。

所以洞并不需要"把地形画出来"，只需要在遮盖层上放一个更小的 SpriteMask，那块区域的 Fog 就不渲染了 —— 于是底下本来就在那的地形直接透出来。视窗的内容不是被"画进去"的，是把上面的盖子掀开。

## 洞本身是什么

两个 `SpriteMask` 对象：`Window_OfLeftChar` 和 `Window_OfRightChar`。它们各挂一个白色 sprite（就是 `White4x4.png`），`localScale = (4, 3)`，所以是一个 4×3 世界单位的矩形洞口。

SpriteMask 通过模板缓冲（stencil）实现：它往模板里写标记，`VisibleOutsideMask` 的精灵读这个标记决定画不画。这是纯 GPU 状态，没有每帧的 CPU 开销，也不需要额外的相机或 RT。

## 一个必须设、否则会出问题的细节

SpriteMask 默认会按排序层/排序号决定影响谁。我在创建时显式设了自定义范围：

```csharp
mask.isCustomRangeActive = true;
mask.frontSortingLayerID = SortingLayer.NameToID("Default");
mask.backSortingLayerID  = SortingLayer.NameToID("Default");
mask.frontSortingOrder = 100;
mask.backSortingOrder  = 0;
```

这个范围 `0..100` 把 Fog（排序 10）包进去了，所以 Fog 会被挖洞。

要注意：角色（排序 20）其实也在这个范围内，但它没被挖掉 —— 因为**受不受遮罩影响是由每个 SpriteRenderer 自己的 `maskInteraction` 决定的**，角色是 `None`，所以模板对它无效。同一个 SpriteMask 可以对 A 生效、对 B 完全不生效，这就是我敢把范围开这么宽的原因。

## 洞怎么跟着角色动

`VisionWindow` 组件只做一件事：

```csharp
public void Refresh()
{
    if (owner == null) return;

    Vector2 target = (Vector2)owner.position + offset;
    if (((Vector2)transform.position - target).sqrMagnitude < 0.000001f) return;

    transform.position = new Vector3(target.x, target.y, 0f);
}
```

`position = owner.position + offset`。左角色的 `offset = (8, 0)`，所以它在左半屏走到哪，洞就在右半屏同高的对应位置 —— 因为偏移只是平移，不是镜像，两者水平方向是**同向**移动的，符合你说的"同步移动"。

三个使用细节：

- **`LateUpdate`**：放在角色移动之后再算，避免这一帧出现洞口滞后一帧的抖动。
- **`OnValidate` + `[ExecuteAlways]`**：在编辑器里拖角色，场景视图能立刻看到洞跟着动，方便摆关卡。
- **提前 return 的容差判断**：洞的位置没变就不写 `transform`，否则 `[ExecuteAlways]` 会让场景每帧变脏，弹出没完没了的未保存提示。

## 为什么选这个方案

当时评估过三种：

| 方案 | 结论 |
|---|---|
| SpriteMask 挖洞 | **选它**。零 shader、零额外相机、URP 2D 下直接能用，改造成本最低 |
| 自定义 shader（遮罩图 + smoothstep） | 能做羽化、扫描线、渐晕，但要写 shader、调试慢 |
| 相机 + RenderTexture | 能做画中画/缩放，开销最大、层级最复杂，这里完全不需要 |

关键判断是：灰盒阶段要验证的是"看不见地形好不好玩"，不是"边缘好不好看"。用 SpriteMask 五分钟能跑起来，如果手感成立，再换 shader 加柔边，代价只是重写一个材质，`VisionWindow` 的跟随逻辑一行都不用动。

## 现在的两个已知局限

1. **边角是硬切的**，没有柔和过渡。换成 shader 才能羽化。
2. **offset 是 8，半屏宽也是 8，而洞宽 4**。角色被墙限制后 x 最小到 -7.59，洞中心就到 0.41，洞左边会伸到 -1.59 —— 也就是会漏出中央墙左侧一小条**本侧**地形。要么把 offset 调到 ±8.5，要么把洞宽收到 3.5，就能消掉。这个数值我一直没动，因为你说过偏移要能独立调，留给你定。

That's an important nuance to state correctly: the mask's sorting range DOES include the characters (order 20 within 0..100), but maskInteraction=None on them means the mask has no effect.

Also explain the stencil mechanism briefly: SpriteMask writes to stencil buffer; sprites with Visible Outside Mask render where stencil is not set.

Let me also give the concrete values from the scene: fog 24x14 covering the view, order 10; masks 4x3 world size, offsets ±8; custom range back 0 front 100 on "Default".

And explain why the window reveals the terrain at the window's own location (not mirrored content): because it's just a hole — same camera, same terrain, same coordinates. The "视窗内容" is literally whatever is under that rectangle. That's a key insight: no second camera, no render texture, no mirrored copy. The offset only moves the hole.

That's the elegant part worth explaining.
